scope: Exact room broadcast guides for existing Tweede Kamer catalogue feeds

primary_evidence.finding: The first-party live page separates plenary and named committee rooms. Public plenary and committee meetings are broadcast; closed meetings are excluded. Planned times may change.
Official app bundle declares api.debatdirect.tweedekamer.nl/api and /agenda/YYYY-MM-DD; date/category/location/slug links identify programmes.

programme_times: Use source startsAt/endsAt explicit offsets; normalize UTC and retain Europe/Amsterdam. Missing or naive ends remain unknown; no inferred ends.
collection: Seven source-calendar dates including today. Each response date must match its requested date and contain a debates collection; genuine empty days stay empty.
tests: Exact room separation; current/cancelled events; explicit repeated autumn clocks; missing ends; wrong date/layout; source-local UTC-midnight window.
limits: Other room IDs require their own catalogue sources before guide mapping.
No playback or new reuse clearance.

other_recorded_lead.finding: Primary indexed page exposes dated linear TV listings, but direct bounded HTTP gets403 with both project and ordinary compatible client headers. No working parser is claimed.
